subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open cross-repo fix candidate, ask the contributor to refresh and prove it, or replace it with a narrow maintainer-owned patch?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open cross-repo PR with closing syntax already claims the fix and is not maintainer-editable, so the next step is a workflow choice rather than another automatic fix PR.

options.title: Replace or adopt narrowly
options.body: Use the open candidate as source context, then land a current-main-compatible patch with focused regression coverage and Croner-compatible edge cases.

options.title: Ask contributor to refresh
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the cross-repo PR author refreshing the branch, adding proof, and adjusting edge cases such as strict numeric-step syntax.

options.title: Defer without a new branch
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not queue repair until maintainers decide the default stagger should cover sub-hourly schedules that include minute zero.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt narrowly
recommendation.body: Use the open candidate as source context, then land a current-main-compatible patch with focused regression coverage and Croner-compatible edge cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The default stagger helper and docs originated in the commit authored by this person, making them the clearest owner for the intended heuristic boundary.
